description: Fictional LINK-FREE messages for evaluating a scam-message text detector for UAE residents. 240 items, 60% scam, 40% legitimate, in four language varieties.

rules: Everything is fictional. The only brand allowed is the invented bank 'Falcon Demo Bank' (Arabic: «بنك الصقر التجريبي»); otherwise use generic roles such as 'your bank', 'the courier', 'the police', 'the traffic authority', 'the telecom provider', 'the electricity company'.
NEVER write any link, domain or URL, in any form.
Phone numbers, when present, must be exactly '0500000000'. Never write other digits for a phone number.
OTP codes, reference numbers: use 'XXXXXX'; amounts like 'AED 350'; never a run of 5 or more digits.
Legitimate OTP notices and warnings must say the code is never to be shared.
No real people, no real companies, no real organisations' phone numbers or addresses. Do not name real apps.
Write the message text entirely in the requested language/script. Keep each message under 400 characters, in the style of a real SMS/WhatsApp text.

examples.text: Falcon Demo Bank: your one-time code is XXXXXX. Never share it with anyone, including bank staff.
examples.label: legitimate

examples.text: Your account shows a problem. Please install the support app we sent and read me the code on your screen.
examples.label: scam
